name: paper-writer
description: Turn Ouroboros run evidence into a venue-ready paper draft through a plugin-owned paper contract, evidence harvest, gap analysis, and verified compose handoff.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Inspect a target repository and report which paper evidence sources are available.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

commands.name: prepare
commands.summary: Generate the plugin-owned paper contract (thesis, venue rules, claims, evidence sufficiency rules).

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

arguments.name: thesis
arguments.description: One-sentence core thesis the paper must argue.

commands.name: harvest
commands.summary: Collect repository evidence (spec, RFDs, domain packs, adapters, conformance, tests, experiment logs) into a research bundle.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

commands.name: gap
commands.summary: Compare contract claims against harvested evidence and emit unsupported-claim actions, including bounded ooo auto goals.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

commands.name: brief
commands.summary: Build the writing brief for the host writer subagent from the contract, bundle, and gap report.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

commands.name: compose
commands.summary: Verify a written draft against the paper contract and evidence bundle, then emit the handoff bundle.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

arguments.name: draft
arguments.description: Path to the draft markdown produced by the writer subagent.

commands.name: revise
commands.summary: Advance the revision loop: record the failed round in the loop ledger, archive its reviews, and emit the writer revision brief with evidence-bound routing.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

commands.name: review
commands.summary: Generate independent reviewer-subagent briefs for the composed draft, or ingest their reviews and enforce the review gate.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

commands.name: latex
commands.summary: Convert the composed, verified paper.md into paper.tex plus references.bib for a local LaTeX build.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to the local repository that is the subject of the paper.

capabilities.name: seed
capabilities.reason: Emit bounded ooo auto goal strings for additional evidence-gathering experiments.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record claim-evidence status, gap decisions, and compose verification results.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record which repository files and experiment logs back each evidence item.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist paper contract, research bundle, gap report, brief, and draft under the target repository.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach the verified paper draft and remaining venue checklist as a handoff bundle.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report evidence readiness and unsupported claims before writing starts.

permissions.reason: Read spec, RFD, domain pack, adapter, conformance, test, and experiment-log files as paper evidence.
Write contract, bundle, gap report, brief, draft, and handoff files into .ouroboros/paper-writer/.
